subject: Performance cycle: succession mapping, delegation matrix & privacy scripts
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, HR Solutions <hr-solutions@example.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Performance cycle: delegation matrix, succession mapping & privacy scripts

Hi all,

I put together an initial bundle for the annual review cycle that we should finalize this quarter. High-level asks below — please review and flag anything missing by EOD Monday (2026-09-21):

1) Delegation matrix (attached: delegation_matrix_v1.xlsx)
   - Which managers are authorized to complete final sign-offs for ICs vs. people in sensitive/supervisory roles.
   - Proposed temporary delegation for managers on parental leave / rotation.

2) Succession mapping (draft in Drive)
   - Priority: list of critical ICs and single-point-of-failure roles. Add candidate backups where available.

3) Privacy-safe comms & manager scripts (attached: privacy_comm_templates.docx)
   - Two variants: public announcement + private manager script for sensitive-role notification. HR Solutions: we need redaction guidance for SOC2 evidence.

4) Blackout window and handover checklist
   - Proposed blackout: 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-22 for calibration and final payouts. Managers should not finalize changes during the blackout unless signed off by HR.

5) Operations: DocuSign process & forms
   - I added a DocuSign placeholder link in related links. We need any legal clauses from Sales or Finance by next Wednesday.

Quick ask: Vivek, can you confirm the manager rotation plan (who covers urgent sign-offs) so I can fold it into the delegation matrix? Jordan — can you take first pass on the manager script language for promotion vs. performance conversations? Marissa — can you validate the blackout window with Payroll? HR Solutions — can you confirm what documentation you need to produce redacted evidence for audits?

Thanks — Evelyn

Evelyn Hart
Head of People Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
T: +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: delegation_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), privacy_comm_templates.docx (docx)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, HR Solutions <hr-solutions@example.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance cycle: delegation matrix, succession mapping & privacy scripts

Evelyn — thanks, this is a solid starting point. A few notes inline: 

- Please add a manager rotation appendix: who covers urgent approvals for each org for 1–2 week intervals. We had gaps last year when two managers took parental leave simultaneously. I can provide the proposed rotation by Friday.

- For the blackout: can we instead make the blackout *soft* between 11/15–11/22 with an exception path (small form) for urgent corrections? That will reduce operational risk for support-facing teams.

- Succession map: request that leaders provide two backup candidates (one lateral, one stretch) where possible. This should be optional for small teams (<5 headcount).

I copied a quick handover checklist below (for inclusion in the final deck):
- Active tasks: list current hiring offers or open candidates
- Critical tickets: ticket numbers and owner
- Pending approvals: comp change approvals in progress

On boarding the rotation plan now.

— Vivek

Hi Evelyn / team,

Thanks for the outline — we can support the redaction and evidence packaging for SOC2 and procurement audits. Notes: 

- We'll provide a redaction checklist and an example redacted packet by 2026-09-24.
- For private manager scripts: avoid including any PII in the manager-facing templates; instead include placeholders (e.g., [EMPLOYEE_FIRST_NAME], [ROLE]) and an internal reference to the secure HR form.
- DocuSign: we recommend two envelopes — one public-facing notification and one sealed HR form for sensitive roles. We can pre-configure templates if you share the final fields.

Attachment: sample_redaction_checklist.pdf (stub)

We'll slot a 30-minute review with you next week — available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Best,
Samira Rahman
Client Success Manager
HR Solutions
samira.rahman@hr-solutions.example
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, HR Solutions <hr-solutions@example.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance cycle: delegation matrix, succession mapping & privacy scripts

Thanks — I pulled the manager script into a separate doc and made a few edits for tone (attached: comm_draft_v3.docx). Key changes:

- Promotion conversations: opening paragraph now emphasizes readiness and next steps (counter-offers, timing).
- Performance conversations: a two-step script (calibrate -> evidence -> next steps) to help managers avoid ambiguous phrasing.
- Added an optional FAQ for managers to give to employees after a sensitive conversation.

Vivek — I included a brief paragraph about the soft-exception process for the blackout. Evelyn — if you want, I can drop this into the Drive folder as a final draft.

Jordan
